content: Locked identity: governed creative-intelligence substrate for enterprise applications. Not AGI/ASI, not a mining product by definition, and not an independently validated superiority claim. Status: source-documented kernel contract retained; external transports, deployed providers and current release qualification remain separate. ## Owned authority Creator-authorised intent, semantic geometry, governed modality providers, world continuity, coherence gating, expression and provenance. One governance boundary; internal organs do not become independent external agents through naming. Provider or world-store adapters must not bypass rights, consent or coherence checks. ## Existing documented in-process API | Surface | Input / output semantics | | --- | --- | | EuclidCreativeKernel.run | Creator directives → governed creative cycle | | EuclidCreativeKernel.refine | Feedback → revised intent and new world lineage | | EuclidCreativeKernel.adapt_world | Bounded interaction → evolution within the same world lineage | | EuclidCreatorAPI | Creator/audience access within the documented permission contract | | ProviderManifest | Provider identity/version, modality, rights handling and deployment status gate | A completed CreativeCycle includes intent, manifold, artifacts, world, coherence, emergence proposals, truth telemetry, expression, provenance head and verification state. Primary schema: EUCLID_CREATIVE_SUBSTRATE_V2; historical source path: euclid/creative_substrate.py. Exact signatures and serialization fixtures require pinned-version export validation; this table does not introduce new argument names. Default blueprints remain rendered=false unless the provider has validated deployment. Default cluster is in-memory. REST/gRPC/WebSocket, distributed durable storage and external provider deployment are explicit integration work, not implied installed capabilities. ## Failure and safety contract Governance runs before creation/refinement. Unresolved rights/intent collisions, unauthorised feedback, world-version regression, same-version forks and invalid provider claims must be refused. Coherence failure raises the documented CoherenceGateError and must not append a completed cycle. Internal chronicle/hash verification does not equal external audit or independent benchmark. ## Non-mining acceptance requirement Create, refine and adapt a governed enterprise creative world; verify deterministic semantic identities, rights rejection, provenance tamper detection, concurrency refusal and honest rendered status. Human satisfaction needs human evaluation. Historical 253-test and harness records are not fresh runs. ## Mining boundary A separately admitted workload adapter may consume planning/creative capabilities. EUCLID does not own Stratum, canonical proof/target, accepted shares, wallets or revenue. Kairos labs retain their no-live-network/no-wallet restrictions. ## Customer schedule State supported in-process interfaces, provider obligations, storage mode, rights/consent responsibilities and deployment scope. No autonomous-agency, rendered-media, distributed-scale or independent-superiority warranty by implication. Pricing, IP/output rights, data processing, support and SLA need explicit commercial/legal approval. ## Source traceability - PROJECT_EUCLID_ARCHITECTURE - EUCLID_DELEGATION - HYBA — Enterprise Product Lock Register
title: EUCLID — Product, Contract & API Lock
